scripts.translation: 對了，你最近怎麼樣？去過阿魯納菲茲嗎？

scripts.text: Wow- Have you met the Pope? Her highness is great. I really like her.
scripts.translation: 哇，你見過教皇嗎？她可了不起了，我特別喜歡她。

scripts.text: I'd really love to meet the Pope. But I am not mentally ready to see the holy face of her highness. I guess I might black out once I see the Pope. If you have time later on, please take me to the Pope.
scripts.translation: 我好想見教皇，可還沒做好瞻仰陛下聖容的心理準備。我怕一見到她就會昏過去。你之後有空的話，帶我去見她吧。

scripts.text: By the way, what are we doing here? Aren't we supposed to meet in ^0000cdEinbech^000000? I have been waiting for a long time and came here. And I found you here.
scripts.translation: 對了，我們現在在這裡做什麼？不是約好在艾音貝赫見面嗎？我等了好久才趕來，結果卻在這裡遇見你。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: They told me to come here.
Hey~ Who? Who said that? There must have been some misunderstanding during the communication. We must go to Einbech.
scripts.translation: 哎~誰？誰讓你來的？溝通時肯定出了什麼差錯。我們得去艾音貝赫。

scripts.text: Well, since I like a train, it doesn't matter how many times I take it.
scripts.translation: 我喜歡坐火車，坐多少次都無所謂。

scripts.text: Let's hurry up. We have a long way to go.
Calm down! I'm just kidding. You are too serious. We are just going to the secret base of the Rebellion in Einbech.
scripts.translation: 別緊張！開個玩笑而已，你也太認真了。我們只是去艾音貝赫的反叛者秘密基地。

scripts.text: I'm just saying that I feel like it is dangerous. I don't mean it will really be dangerous. Calm down.
scripts.translation: 我只是覺得那裡聽起來挺危險，不是說真的會有危險。放輕鬆。

scripts.text: If we are negotiating with the Rebellion, why are we going to Einbech instead of Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 既然要和反叛者談判，為什麼去艾音貝赫而不是艾音布羅克？

scripts.text: Have you heard of the mercenary revolt in Schwaltzvalt?
scripts.translation: 你聽說過施瓦茨瓦爾特的傭兵叛亂嗎？

scripts.text: To tell you briefly, the mercenaries were used as a garrison of the republic. But as the republic developed a Guardian, they were about to be abandoned. Then the mercenaries rose in revolt and were nearly annihilated.
scripts.translation: 簡單來說，傭兵曾擔任共和國的守備部隊。後來共和國開發出守護者，傭兵眼看就要被拋棄，於是發動叛亂，最後幾乎全軍覆沒。

scripts.text: Some of the remnants went to Figel, But the rest of them gathered in Einbech and Einbroch to organize the Rebellion. By the way, Einbroch is a large city where many people live ans pass by. Isn't it?
scripts.translation: 一部分殘黨逃到了菲格爾，其餘的人則聚集在艾音貝赫和艾音布羅克，成立了反叛者組織。艾音布羅克人來人往，是座大城市，對吧？

scripts.text: So the Rebellion put their guild in Einbroch. The rest of them were hiding somewhere else in Einbroch. That's why I suggested you to meet in Einbech..
scripts.translation: 反叛者把公會設在艾音布羅克，其他成員則藏身在艾音布羅克的其他地方。這就是我提議在艾音貝赫見面的原因。

scripts.text: Anyway, the government was overlooking the remnants for various reasons. I'm sure the government is still uncomfortable about it.
scripts.translation: 總之，政府出於各種原因一直對這些殘黨睜一隻眼閉一隻眼。我敢說，政府現在還是覺得很棘手。

scripts.text: That's why this negotiation is so important. We are going to asking for help to the guy who's angry at me. It won't be easy.
scripts.translation: 所以這次談判才這麼重要。我們要向一個恨我的傢伙求助，肯定不會輕鬆。

scripts.text: We should them a sense of apology and a promise of hope in the future. At the same time, ^0000cdwe have to relax their mind and promise with them to cooperate in future affairs^000000...
scripts.translation: 我們得表達歉意，也要讓他們看到未來的希望。同時，安撫他們，並承諾今後會與他們合作... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Just by listening to it, it sounds really difficult.
scripts.translation: 光聽你說就覺得很難辦。

scripts.text: The most difficult thing is how to enter the ^0000cdsecret base^000000 rather than talking to them.
scripts.translation: 比起怎麼跟他們談，真正難的是怎麼進入秘密基地。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Anyway, we will think about the method on our way there. You Just trust me and follow me. Nothing is impossible as long as you trust me. You can trust me in any situation.
scripts.translation: 路上再想辦法吧。你只要相信我，跟著我就行。只要信任我，沒有什麼辦不到。無論什麼時候都可以相信我。

scripts.text: I don't have much faith in you.
It's okay, because I trust myself. Out of all these people in this large world, I am the only one whom I trust. So you just follow me.
scripts.translation: 沒關係，我信我自己。這世上這麼多人，我只相信自己。你跟著我就行。

scripts.text: You have great faith in yourself.
Of course. If I don't feel confident about myself, I can't do this job.
scripts.translation: 當然。對自己沒信心，怎麼做這份工作？

scripts.text: Sometimes I have to face some unpleasant situation, and do things that are not sometimes moral. But for my task and survival, I must not hesitate to make momentary decisions and execute my actions.
scripts.translation: 有時我得面對糟心的處境，甚至做些不太道德的事。但為了任務和生存，我必須果斷決策，立刻行動。

scripts.text: And let's say you begin to doubt it. Once your mind starts to shake, the task will be in danger. Unwavering confidence is more important than anything else.
scripts.translation: 要是你開始懷疑自己，心一動搖，任務就會陷入險境。堅定的信念比什麼都重要。

scripts.text: Of course, you need the capability to support your confidence. You can't trust anything without evidence.
scripts.translation: 當然，自信也得有本事支撐。沒有依據，什麼都不能輕信。

scripts.text: After listening to what you said, I don't fully trust you. But I feel like having to trust you.
scripts.translation: 聽你這麼一說，我雖然還沒完全信任你，但感覺也只能信你了。

scripts.text: It's quite natural. Very good. Good luck in our mission. My goal is to build a reputation of a fantastic duo with you.
scripts.translation: 這很正常。很好，祝我們任務順利。我希望咱倆能成為一對名聲響亮的搭檔。

scripts.text: The ticket gate is over there! We have to pay for the train. Are you saying we will walk there?
scripts.translation: 檢票口在那邊！坐火車得買票。你是想走過去嗎？

scripts.text: Yikes! Pipe down!! Of course we are taking a train. In a special place and in a special way.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，小聲點！！我們當然坐火車，只不過要用特別的方法，從特別的地方上車。

scripts.text: If you want to call it a free ride, go ahead. But do you really want to discount your action as a 'free ride'? You can used the elegant expression 'occupation after closed infiltration'.
scripts.translation: 你要叫逃票也行。不過，你真想把自己的行動說成“逃票”嗎？可以說得體面一點，叫作“秘密潛入後的佔領行動”。

scripts.text: Usually, we can feel buy tickets, say hello to the station staff eat delicious snacks, and enjoy our trip.
scripts.translation: 平常我們可以買票、和車站工作人員打招呼、買點好吃的零食，悠閒地享受旅程。

scripts.text: But we are in the middle of a mission. It's already begun. It's kind of an emergency. So we have to be tense.
scripts.translation: 但我們正在執行任務，行動已經開始了，情況緊急，當然得繃緊神經。

scripts.text: I really don't understand the relationship between being tense and free riding.
scripts.translation: 我還是不明白，繃緊神經和逃票有什麼關係。

scripts.text: Do you really thing I'm just trying to save 200 Zeny? I know what I'm doing. You just follow me without nagging. We are in a hurry.
scripts.translation: 你真以為我只是想省200 Zeny？我自有打算。別再嘮叨了，跟上我，我們趕時間。

scripts.text: Why aren't you following me? We might miss the train!
scripts.translation: 你怎麼還不跟上？要趕不上火車了！

scripts.text: Long time no see! I'm going to another mission spot. Got it? See you later!
scripts.translation: 好久不見！我要去另一個任務地點了，知道了嗎？回頭見！

scripts.text: Are you okay to be here now?
scripts.translation: 你現在在這裡沒問題吧？

scripts.text: Long time no see! I'm going to another mission spot. Got it? See you later!
scripts.translation: 好久不見！我要去另一個任務地點了，知道了嗎？回頭見！

scripts.text: It is a small hole where one person can barely pass through.
scripts.translation: 這是個小洞，只勉強容得下一個人通過。

scripts.text: You passed through the hole where one person can barely enter.
scripts.translation: 你從那個僅容一人勉強通過的小洞裡鑽了過去。

scripts.text: We are going to take a train here. Do you see ^0000cdvery small hole^000000 in the sewer down there?
scripts.translation: 我們要從這裡搭火車。看到下面下水道里的那個小洞了嗎？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Is this... a ^0000cddoghole^000000? I heard the Secret Wings is an executive office of the President. Why are you so needy?
scripts.translation: 這...是個狗洞嗎？我聽說秘密之翼是總統的行政機關。你們怎麼這麼寒酸？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Shh--- I told you not to mention that name. Be careful from now on. I don't want to be stabbed on my back for something I didn't do. If you really want to say it, call it Heron.
scripts.translation: 噓---我不是說過別提那個名字嗎？之後小心點。我可不想因為沒做過的事被人在背後捅刀。真要提的話，就叫它“白鷺”。

scripts.text: I mean, why do you have to go through a place like this? Don't they pay you any activity cost? Maybe his excellency doesn't care for all your comfort.
scripts.translation: 我是說，你為什麼非得從這種地方走？他們不給你發行動經費嗎？也許總統根本不在乎你過得舒不舒服。

scripts.text: It's not true. We receive a free pass to use all means of transportation in this continent. They includes airship, train and teleporting, etc.
scripts.translation: 不是這樣的。我們擁有使用本大陸所有交通工具的免費通行證。包括飛空艇、火車和傳送等。

scripts.text: Then why do you have to go through a place like this?
scripts.translation: 那你們為什麼非要走這種地方？

scripts.text: Because we don't want to leave the records. We must not be detected by others. Although we get captured, our moving route must be hidden. The moving routes can be a great clue.
scripts.translation: 因為我們不想留下記錄。我們必須不被他人發現。即使我們被抓住了，我們的移動路線也必須隱藏。移動路線可能會成為重要的線索。

scripts.text: No wonder we have the word 'secret' in our name. That's why I move so carefully during my mission.
scripts.translation: 難怪我們的名字裡有“秘密”這個詞。這就是為什麼我在執行任務時如此小心。

scripts.text: To avoid being detected, duck yourself and follow me.
scripts.translation: 為了不被發現，請低下頭，跟著我。

scripts.text: Yuno~ Visit Yuno~ If you were born as a human, go to Yuno~ If you have come to Schwaltzvalt, go to Yuno~ If you are breathing, go to Yuno~
scripts.translation: 朱諾~ 去見朱諾~ 如果你生而為人，就去朱諾那裡~ 如果你來到了施瓦茨瓦爾特，就去朱諾那裡~ 如果你還在呼吸，就去朱諾那裡~

scripts.text: He told me he'd come here. Maybe he's still in Einbroch train station? I have to go there again.
scripts.translation: 他告訴我他會來這裡。也許他還在艾音布羅克火車站？我得再去一趟。

scripts.text: This is Einbech. The last time I came here, I was being chased by 17 pursuers.
scripts.translation: 這裡是艾音貝赫。上次我來這裡的時候，被17個追捕者追著跑。

scripts.text: I'm sorry I can't tell more than that. It's confidential.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不能透露更多。這是機密。

scripts.text: Hey! I just cracked a joke before starting on the mission. You can't even accept?
scripts.translation: 嘿！任務開始前開個玩笑而已，你連這個都受不了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm a little nervous. A negotiation...
scripts.translation: 我有點緊張。畢竟是要去談判...

scripts.text: You don't have to be nervous. I'm going to be in charge of talking to them. You just add several words beside me.
scripts.translation: 不用緊張，談判由我負責。你只要在旁邊附和幾句就好。

scripts.text: In this mission, the trust is important. There is a reason why the government assigned you to this mission in addition to me, a professional negotiator.
scripts.translation: 這次任務的關鍵是信任。政府除了派我這位專業談判人員，也派了你來，自有原因。

scripts.text: You are known as a hero in this Midgard continent and a symbol of trust. If you come with me, the Rebellion will be less stubborn to us. Once we get trusted by them, everything will work out.
scripts.translation: 你在米德加爾特大陸上是公認的英雄，也是信任的象徵。有你同行，反叛者對我們的戒心就會少一些。只要取得他們的信任，一切都會順利。

scripts.text: Talking like that in that clothes, you don't look very persuasive.
scripts.translation: 穿成這樣說這種話，實在沒什麼說服力。

scripts.text: This is my critical costume I prepared for this mission. Who would ever find a tourist suspicious?
scripts.translation: 這是我為這次任務準備的特別裝扮。誰會懷疑一個遊客呢？

scripts.text: As I mentioned before, our greatest challenge is to enter the Rebellion's secret base without any armed conflict. This costume is for that purpose.
scripts.translation: 正如我之前說的，最大的難題是不引發衝突，進入反叛者的秘密基地。這身裝扮就是為此準備的。

scripts.text: And Yuno is such a nice place. I have a dream to buy a building there after retirement and spend my golden years comfortably.
scripts.translation: 而且朱諾是個好地方。我夢想退休後在那裡買棟房子，舒舒服服地安度晚年。

scripts.text: Don't they normally choose a resort like Comodo for golden years?
scripts.translation: 通常人們不是會選克魔島這樣的度假勝地安度晚年嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, I don't like a beach. I saw the sea every single day when I was young. Now I'm sick of its salty smell. To leave the sea, I used to have a dream to become a captain of airship.
scripts.translation: 哦，我不喜歡海灘。小時候天天見海，現在聞到鹹鹹的海風都膩了。為了離開大海，我以前還夢想過當飛空艇船長呢。

scripts.text: If you wanted to become a pilot, why did you become a secret agent?
scripts.translation: 既然你想當飛空艇駕駛員，怎麼後來成了特工？

scripts.text: I can't tell you. It's confidential.
Oh, when you get back after the mission, you can purchase a train ticket and show it to the employee in the train station. But it's free for me.
scripts.translation: 任務結束後回來時，記得買張火車票給站務員看。不過我坐車不用買票。

scripts.text: Well, where should we go now?
scripts.translation: 那麼，我們現在該去哪裡？

scripts.text: We have go somewhere deep inside the village. From here on, just trust me and follow me. Since the path is a little complicated, I will leave ^0000cdtraces^000000. Make sure you catch them up.
scripts.translation: 我們得去村子深處。從這裡開始，你只管相信我，跟著我走。路有點複雜，我會留下記號，記得跟上。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What are you doing? I told you to follow me.
scripts.translation: 你在幹什麼？我讓你跟著我。

scripts.text: We are not supposed to be here now.
We must go to the rebellion.
Long time no see! I'm going to another mission spot. Got it? See you later!
scripts.translation: 好久不見！我要去另一個任務地點了。明白了嗎？回頭見！

scripts.text: Wait. Stop right there. Somebody is lying down here. Don't step on it. Hey, watch out!
scripts.translation: 等等，先停下。這裡有人躺著，別踩到他！小心！

scripts.text: If I get rid of this and that...!
scripts.translation: 要是把這個和那個都處理掉...！

scripts.text: Wow... I think today is a lucky day. This mission is going to be easier than we thought.
scripts.translation: 哇...看來今天運氣真好。這次任務會比想像中輕鬆。

scripts.text: What's written on the bottom? Dying message? Are they words? How come he never practiced writing even if he was a Gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 底下寫了什麼？遺言嗎？這是字嗎？他明明是個槍手，怎麼連字都沒練好？

scripts.text: Adventurer, try to heal this man. Although he has an injury, it's not so serious. Since he's collapsed due to an exhaustion, he'll probably recover himself by a simple treatment. Once he wakes up, I will take all the information from him.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，試著給這個人治療一下。他傷得不重，只是累倒了，簡單處理一下應該就能恢復。等他醒來，我就問他要情報。

scripts.text: I don't know how to heal.
Well, I have no other choice.
Odin, Freyja, Thor and a god of exhausted traveler. Please show us a mercy!
scripts.translation: 奧丁、芙蕾雅、托爾，還有疲憊旅人的守護神啊，請賜予我們慈悲吧！

scripts.text: Wow... You're a secret agent and you also know how to heal?
scripts.translation: 哇...你是特工，居然還會治療？

scripts.text: Oh, after experiencing so many things, you should do it all.
scripts.translation: 經歷了這麼多事情，當然得樣樣都會啊。

scripts.text: I'am so good at various arts and craft. I am such a great person.
scripts.translation: 我精通各種技藝，真是個了不起的人。

scripts.text: He won't wake up immediately, but he'll save his life anyway. If we were too late, he would have died.
scripts.translation: 他不會馬上醒來，不過至少保住性命了。要是再晚一點，他恐怕就沒命了。

scripts.text: What are you doing? Carry him.
scripts.translation: 你還愣著幹什麼？把他背起來。

scripts.text: Are we carrying him? I thought we were on a secret mission.
scripts.translation: 要揹著他走？我還以為我們在執行秘密任務呢。

scripts.text: We ^0000cdmust bring^000000 him. No matter what happens, we must bring this man. He will be our ticket to the base.
scripts.translation: 我們必須帶上他。無論如何都得把他帶走，他會是我們進入基地的通行證。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Good question. But since we don't have enough time, let me explain later. We must deliver him before he dies.
scripts.translation: 問得好。不過時間緊迫，我之後再解釋。得趕在他斷氣前把他送出去。

scripts.text: What are you doing? I told you to follow me.
scripts.translation: 你在幹什麼？我讓你跟著我。

scripts.text: Put down what you have carried.
Where am I? There's nobody here.
scripts.translation: 我在哪兒？這裡一個人也沒有。

scripts.text: You can see as much as you know. That's why I'm always tired. People all want me to look at them.
scripts.translation: 你能看到多少，取決於你知道多少。所以我才總是這麼累，人人都想讓我替他們看清一切。

scripts.text: You talk too much! I told you we don't have much time. You can listen to my explanation later. Someone who was standing in front of this detected me already and went inside. We don't know what they will prepare.
scripts.translation: 你話太多了！我說過時間不多，解釋之後再說。剛才有人守在這裡，發現我之後就進去了。我們不知道他們會有什麼準備。

scripts.text: Wait, are we going to leave him here?
scripts.translation: 等等，要把他留在這裡嗎？

scripts.text: Yeah. Is there any problem? Is it a problem? Could it be a problem?
scripts.translation: 是啊。有問題嗎？這有問題嗎？這會有問題嗎？

scripts.text: You said that we should bring the injured man. Then you told me to carry him all the way here. Now you are abandoning him here?
scripts.translation: 你剛才還說得帶上傷者，讓我一路把他背到這裡。現在卻要把他丟在這兒？

scripts.text: Don't worry about him. He's not going to die. Humans do not die so easily. The fact I'm still alive is the evidence.
scripts.translation: 別擔心，他死不了。人沒那麼容易死，我還活著就是證據。

scripts.text: Come on, let's get in. We don't have much time. Let's talk inside. Aren't you curious to know what's in there?
scripts.translation: 快進去，時間不多了。進去再聊。你不好奇裡面有什麼嗎？

scripts.text: We have to see something to get in there.
scripts.translation: 我們得先找到入口才能進去吧。

scripts.text: Look at this. There's an entrance here. This is ^0000cdan entrance hidden in the wall of the beach^000000. It is so fishy. Let's get inside and check what's there.
scripts.translation: 看這裡，這裡有個入口。入口藏在海灘的牆壁裡，真可疑。進去看看裡面有什麼。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: What are you doing? Come in!
Oh, welcome. This is a weapon store, Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation: 哦，歡迎光臨。這是克拉納·內米埃裡武器店。

scripts.text: In this store, even a small sound creates a huge resonant due to its structure. Please be quite when entering here.
scripts.translation: 這家店的結構會讓細微的聲音產生很大的迴響。進來時請保持安靜。

scripts.text: A real customer!! We have a customer in this period...
scripts.translation: 有客人！！這種時候居然還有客人...

scripts.text: Who are you? This is not a place where anyone can come in. Please leave.
scripts.translation: 你是誰？這裡不是誰都能進來的地方。請離開。

scripts.text: Ouch! The store looks smaller that it looks from outside. Is there a space behind the pillar?
scripts.translation: 哎喲！這家店裡面看起來比外面還小。柱子後面是不是還有空間？

scripts.text: Welcome. This is ^0000cdClana Nemieri^000000 and we handle various firearms.
scripts.translation: 歡迎光臨，這裡是克拉納·內米埃裡，專營各種槍械。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Take a look around and tell me if there is anything you are looking for.
scripts.translation: 請隨意看看，想找什麼就告訴我。

scripts.text: Yeah.. I hope we have what you're looking for.
scripts.translation: 嗯...希望這裡有你要找的東西。

scripts.text: By the way... How did you find us? This is a small store that only limited people visit.
scripts.translation: 對了...你是怎麼找到這裡的？這家小店平時沒幾個人來。

scripts.text: I wanted to buy a self-defense gun. And someone recommended me this store.
scripts.translation: 我想買把防身槍，有人推薦我來這家店。

scripts.text: What would you do if I tell you who that person is?
scripts.translation: 我告訴您那個人是誰，您又打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Wow, this looks cool. Is this the way you hold it?
scripts.translation: 哇，這個看起來挺酷。是這樣握的嗎？

scripts.text: Sir. That stuff is quite sensitive and you shouldn't tough it inconsiderately.
scripts.translation: 先生，那東西很精密，請不要隨便碰。

scripts.text: Didn't you tell me to look all I want? This is so small! Can it ever fire a bullet? Look at the dust here. I guess you're out of business here.
scripts.translation: 不是您讓我隨便看的嗎？這也太小了！真能打出子彈嗎？看看上面的灰，看來你們生意不太好啊。

scripts.text: Oh.. That's one of the most popular products in our store.
scripts.translation: 哦...那可是本店最暢銷的商品之一。

scripts.text: Is this a popular product? I can imagine the quality of this store.
scripts.translation: 這是暢銷貨？我都能想像這家店的品質了。

scripts.text: What did you say? Are you insulting my gun now?
scripts.translation: 你說什麼？你是在侮辱我的槍嗎？

scripts.text: No, I don't mean it. But if you heard it that way, then it's an insult.
scripts.translation: 我不是那個意思。不過您要是這麼理解，那就算我侮辱您了。

scripts.text: Calm down, Nemi. He's a customer.
Hmm... This looks quite good. How much is it?
scripts.translation: 嗯...這個看起來不錯，多少錢？

scripts.text: That's the price of a snack. Give me one.
scripts.translation: 這價錢跟零食差不多。給我來一把。

scripts.text: Since it is a display product, we have to place an order. There are too many orders and you have to wait for eight months. Can you wait?
scripts.translation: 這是展示品，得另外訂購。訂單太多，要等八個月。你等得了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm not the one who's short-tempered. I guess it's you.
scripts.translation: 脾氣急的人可不是我，我看是你吧。

scripts.text: Rather than these, show me what you actually sell here. For example, ^0000cdFast Grinder Cutting through the Wind^000000?
scripts.translation: 比起這些，拿點你們真正賣的東西給我看看。比如疾風切割機？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hey, who the hell are you?
Can't you see? I am a tourist and this is my secretary.
scripts.translation: 看不出來嗎？我是遊客，這是我的秘書。

scripts.text: Which tourist comes all the way to the weapon store in a mining village where there is nothing to see? Where do you come from?
scripts.translation: 哪個遊客會大老遠跑到這座沒什麼景點的礦業村，專程來武器店？你們從哪兒來的？

scripts.text: I just arrived from Yuno. I went there and it was so~ wonderful.
scripts.translation: 我剛從朱諾來。那裡真是~太棒了。

scripts.text: Go back. We don't have what you want.
scripts.translation: 回去吧，這裡沒有你要的東西。

scripts.text: So you're kicking us out? Mr. Nemieri. You can't do this.
scripts.translation: 所以你要趕我們走？內米埃裡先生，您不能這樣。

scripts.text: Why can't I kick you out? Go away before call someone.
scripts.translation: 我為什麼不能趕你走？趁我叫人之前，趕緊離開。

scripts.text: You'd better take a look who's out there. His name was... ^0000cdGonie^000000. Right?
scripts.translation: 你最好出去看看是誰來了。他叫...戈尼，對吧？ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Just go outside and check it yourself.
scripts.translation: 你自己出去看看不就知道了。

scripts.text: I won't tolerate you if you're playing shallow tricks.
scripts.translation: 要是你敢耍什麼小把戲，我可不會放過你。
他一個人能把那人抬走嗎？

scripts.text: Is the collapsed guy from here?
scripts.translation: 那個昏倒的人是從這裡出來的嗎？

scripts.text: Didn't you know? That's why we struggled to bring him all the way here. Now look. He will use a magic after a short while.
scripts.translation: 你還不知道嗎？我們費了好大勁才把他一路帶到這裡。看著吧，他等會兒就會施法。

scripts.text: Oh, my goodness. Gonie! What happened!
Hey, what did you to this guy?
scripts.translation: 喂，你們對這傢伙做了什麼？

scripts.text: Well, we did something. He was nearly dead and we brought him all the way here by keeping him alive. That was a great job.
scripts.translation: 是，我們確實做了點事。他當時都快沒命了，我們一路把他救活、帶到這裡。我們可是幫了大忙。

scripts.text: Didn't you hurt him to take him as a hostage?
scripts.translation: 你們是不是為了把他當人質，才把他弄傷的？

scripts.text: Why would I hand over the person I took hostage to you? If you really don't know what happened, wake him up and ask him. What would you do if we didn't hurt him?
scripts.translation: 我抓了人質，怎麼還會把他交給你們？你要是真不知道發生了什麼，就叫醒他問問。要是我們沒傷他，你又打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text: You'll be so embarrassed, sorry and ashamed. Would you even lift your head up?
scripts.translation: 到時候你會尷尬、愧疚又羞愧，恐怕連頭都抬不起來吧？

scripts.text: Why are you doubting us so much? Enough is enough. Not many villains try to swindle with an injured person.
scripts.translation: 你們幹嗎這麼懷疑我們？夠了吧。哪有惡棍會拿傷員來騙人？

scripts.text: This is unfair. I've been victimized! Father! Mother!!
scripts.translation: 這不公平！明明是我受了委屈！爸爸！媽媽！！

scripts.text: Nemi, what happened? Is Gonie dead?

scripts.text: He was nearly dead and we brought him all the way here by keeping him alive~ It was so tough~~

scripts.text: He's not doing very well. We have to take him there and lay him down. Wake up, Gonie. Can you walk?
scripts.translation: 他情況不太好。得把他抬到那邊躺下。戈尼，醒醒。能走嗎？

scripts.text: It will be difficult now. You will have to carry him. If it is hard for you, you can order my strong secretary to lift him~
scripts.translation: 他現在走不了，得有人揹他。你要是背不動，可以叫我這位強壯的秘書來幫忙哦~

scripts.text: Oh, dear! You dropped him. Maybe you have been overworking.
scripts.translation: 哎呀！你把他摔了。看來你最近太累了。

scripts.text: He opened his eyes! Looks like he is conscious!
scripts.translation: 他睜眼了！好像醒過來了！

scripts.text: No, he opened his eyes instinctively due to the impact. He's still unconscious.
scripts.translation: 不，他只是被撞得本能地睜開眼睛，還沒醒呢。

scripts.text: Gonie! Are you all right? Stand up.
My god! You dropped him again. Don't work too hard.
scripts.translation: 天哪！你又把他摔了。別太勉強自己啊。

scripts.text: Gonie! What happened to you? Stand up again.
scripts.translation: 戈尼！你怎麼了？再站起來試試。

scripts.text: Gosh, why is your arm you so weak? Seems like this place is in trouble. You have no manpower so you hired such a weak person? My god.
scripts.translation: 天哪，你胳膊怎麼這麼沒勁？看來這裡真是缺人手，才會僱這麼弱的人？我的天。

scripts.text: I don't know who you are. But I hear what you're saying!
scripts.translation: 我不知道你是誰，不過我聽見你說的話了！

scripts.text: Hear what? I was just speaking inside!

scripts.text: Gonie! Why are you so bloody? Did they attack you?

scripts.text: you! It's because of you! You just can't lift him! Come on. Let's carry him together. You are so weak that you cannot lift anything heavier than a spoon.

scripts.text: Don't give Lucky too much pressure.
I barely saved his life and now you're trying to kill him. It's a fortune that he is unconscious and cannot feel the pain.
scripts.translation: 我好不容易才救了他的命，你們現在卻要害死他。幸好他昏迷了，感覺不到疼。

scripts.text: Thanks, Nemi. Arrgh. Let's bring him and lay him down.

scripts.text: Oh, I heard about you briefly. Thank you very much for saving my friend and taking him all the way here. The shop owner will compensate you.

scripts.text: Wait! They're sending us away like this? Seems like they are. Did I get it wrong?
scripts.translation: 等等！就這樣給點錢把我們打發走了？好像還真是。我是不是理解錯了？

scripts.text: Oops? They went inside! Come on!

scripts.text: Who kicks me out! That's impossible! I will lie down here! Come out!
scripts.translation: 誰敢趕我？沒門！我就躺在這裡！出來！

scripts.text: Your voice is so loud that it hurts my ears. Normally, stupid people have huge voices.
scripts.translation: 你的聲音太大了，吵得我耳朵疼。通常，愚蠢的人聲音都很大。

scripts.text: I see. Come in. We can give you a cup of tea as you wish.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。進來吧。我們可以按你的要求給你倒杯茶。

scripts.text: Look at him. He can't even hurt us.
scripts.translation: 看看他。他連傷害我們的能力都沒有。

scripts.text: I feel weird, but I will skip it. Oh! I'm so thirsty~
scripts.translation: 我覺得有點奇怪，但我就免了吧。哦！我渴死了~

scripts.translation: 有人來了，我想他是來找你的。雖然

scripts.translation: 你幫了人就這麼愛居功嗎？

scripts.text: You have to exaggerate your performance. That's the way to be appreciated by others.
scripts.translation: 得把功勞說得誇張點，別人才會賞識你嘛。

scripts.text: So, why did you come here? By the way, who are you?
scripts.translation: 那麼，你們來這裡做什麼？對了，你們是誰？

scripts.text: Me? Lazy. Although it's not my real name, call me Lazy now.
scripts.translation: 我？叫我懶散就行，雖然這不是真名。

scripts.text: I am an, ^0000cdagent of Secret Wings^000000, an institution directly responsible to the President of Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation: 我是秘密之翼的特工，該機構直接向施瓦茨瓦爾特總統負責。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hey! Why did you tell them who you are all of a sudden? You kept telling me not even to mention it. And you revealed it officially!
scripts.translation: 喂！你怎麼突然把身份說出來了？你之前還一直叫我別提這件事，結果自己倒是公開說了！

scripts.text: It's all right. This is our destination. ^0000cdClana Nemieri^000000, the stronghold of Rebellions.
scripts.translation: 沒關係，這裡就是我們的目的地——克拉納·內米埃裡，反叛者的據點。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Then the store outside the door was a ^0000cdtrickery^000000. The collapsed man is a member of ^0000cdRebellion^000000... That's why...
scripts.translation: 所以門外那家店只是個幌子，那個倒下的人是反叛者成員...我明白了... ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hey, calm down please! Put your guns in! No wonder you are hot headed elders!!
scripts.translation: 喂，冷靜點！把槍收起來！難怪你們這些老前輩脾氣這麼火爆！！

scripts.text: Although they have come here with a fishy purpose, it's true that they carried injured Gonie all the way here. Behave yourself, old men.
scripts.translation: 他們的目的雖然可疑，但確實一路把受傷的戈尼背了過來。你們這些老傢伙，冷靜點。

scripts.text: You are not surprised? So you knew it.
scripts.translation: 你一點也不驚訝？看來你早就知道了。

scripts.text: I didn't know who you were. But I knew you had a certain purpose. I had not told you my name but you were shouting 'Come out Rookie'. So I had a clue.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你們是誰，但知道你們另有目的。我還沒告訴你名字，你就在喊“新人出來”，這讓我起了疑心。

scripts.text: I heard that the brain of a Rebellion is filled with bullets, but maybe not every Rebellion! So, is your name Lucky, or Rookie?
scripts.translation: 我聽說反叛者個個腦子裡都裝著子彈，不過看來也不是所有人都這樣嘛！所以你到底叫拉基還是新人？

scripts.text: Rookie! You already knew who he was, and you..!!
scripts.translation: 新人！你早就知道他們是誰了吧？你這傢伙...！

scripts.text: I told you! Old men, are you deaf now? I didn't know who they were! This is unfair!
scripts.translation: 我說了，我不知道他們是誰！老傢伙們，你們聾了嗎？這不公平！

scripts.text: If they had an intention to attack us, they would have done it already, rather than asking for tea. And what can these two do against many of us?
scripts.translation: 他們要是想襲擊我們，早就動手了，何必坐下來喝茶？而且就他們兩個，能拿我們這麼多人怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Whatever they do, you are going to handle them. Aren't you? You are legends of the Rebellion.
scripts.translation: 不管他們打什麼主意，你們這些反叛者傳奇人物肯定能應付吧？

scripts.text: I don't know where they come from. But by the time they came all the way here, perhaps they need to talk to the seniors. I will bring the tea and enjoy the talk.
scripts.translation: 我不知道他們來自哪裡，但他們大老遠趕來，肯定有事要和前輩們談。我去泡茶，順便聽聽。

scripts.text: Hahaha! Nice to meet you. Did I surprise you by coming in all of a sudden in leisure hours?
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈！很高興見到各位。我突然在休息時間來訪，沒打擾你們吧？

scripts.text: But I am not a dangerous person, so please relax. And this adventurer is much less dangerous.
scripts.translation: 不過我不是什麼危險人物，放輕鬆。至於這位冒險者，就更沒什麼威脅了。

scripts.text: This person is an adventurer who settled various problems of the continent, including Schwaltzvalt. The adventurer is currently under the protection of Rune Midgarts Kingdom.{0}
scripts.translation: 這位冒險者解決過大陸各地的問題，包括施瓦茨瓦爾特的麻煩，目前受到盧恩·米德加茲王國的保護。 {0}

scripts.text: And I am a member of Secret Wings, an institution directly responsible to the President of Schwaltzvalt Republic. Since the President guarantees my identification, you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation: 我是秘密之翼的成員，直接向施瓦茨瓦爾特共和國總統負責。總統能證明我的身份，你們不用擔心。

scripts.text: You are the most dangerous guy here!
scripts.translation: 你才是這裡最危險的人！

scripts.text: President? Since I heard that unpleasant word, let me wash my ears!
scripts.translation: 總統？光聽到這個討厭的詞，我就想洗洗耳朵！

scripts.text: What is a spoiled crow of the President doing here?
scripts.translation: 總統的寵兒跑到這裡來幹什麼？

scripts.text: That's what I am about to tell you now. Haha. So please put your guns down... Let's sit down first.
scripts.translation: 這正是我要解釋的事。哈哈，先把槍放下...我們坐下來談吧。

scripts.text: Hey, you are standing up too!
Ahaha. I've got a disease that I can't sit down. By the way... As a guest, I couldn't come here with empty hands. This is a specialty good of Yuno... Please have some.
scripts.translation: 啊哈哈，我有病，坐不下來。對了...既然是客人，總不能空手來。這是尤諾特產...請嚐嚐。

scripts.text: What do you mean by guest? We never invited you.
scripts.translation: 你算什麼客人？我們可沒邀請你。

scripts.text: We never know what you put on this food! There is nothing we would like to hear from you. So get out of here!
scripts.translation: 誰知道你在食物裡下了什麼！我們沒什麼要聽的，滾出去！

scripts.text: As soon as you drink the tea, leave at once~ We won't see you off!
scripts.translation: 喝完就趕緊走~我們可不送你！

scripts.text: Where are you going? I brought the tea in reference to the number of people here.
scripts.translation: 你去哪兒？我可是照人數把茶都拿來了。

scripts.text: I don't drink tea in uncomfortable place. I don't want to have an upset stomach while drinking tea.
scripts.translation: 我才不在這種不自在的地方喝茶，免得喝得胃不舒服。

scripts.text: Come on, what's wrong with you~ You can drink it so quickly. It's not good after it gets cold. Your stomach must have got cold by now. You're not so healthy either.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，你這是怎麼了~茶得趁熱喝，涼了就不好了。你的胃八成已經著涼了，身體也不太好嘛。

scripts.text: Can't you just drink the tea before leaving? I struggled to get this tea... You also liked it...
scripts.translation: 喝完茶再走不行嗎？我費了好大勁才弄到這些茶...你明明也喜歡喝...

scripts.text: And if we feel uncomfortable, they also feel uncomfortable. So it's not such a bad condition. Come on. Drinking a cup of tea is not a hard thing to do.
scripts.translation: 而且我們不舒服，他們也會不舒服，這不正好嗎？來吧，喝杯茶又不難。

scripts.text: I mean, the spoiled crow of the President-
Please. The tea is innocent. have a peaceful tea time. Never fight in front of food. You taught me all these words. Didn't you?
scripts.translation: 拜託，茶是無辜的。大家好好喝茶，別在食物面前爭吵。這些話不都是你教我的嗎？

scripts.text: Wow~ This tea is great. It matches well with this specialty good. Try it. The President prepared it for you.
scripts.translation: 哇~這茶真好喝，配這道特色點心正合適。嚐嚐吧，這是總裁特意為你準備的。

scripts.text: Please listen to me. I'm here to ask you a very difficult request.
scripts.translation: 請聽我說。我這次來，是想拜託你們一件非常棘手的事。

scripts.text: Why should we accept a difficult request?
scripts.translation: 我們為什麼要接受一個困難的請求？

scripts.text: That's why I came here. This mission cannot be accomplished by anyone except Rebellion. So the President sent me here.
scripts.translation: 所以我才來這裡。這項任務只有反叛者才能完成，總裁才派我前來。

scripts.text: I think it will be such a confidential and cautious story. Please take this...
scripts.translation: 這件事需要高度保密，也得謹慎處理。請先收下這個...

scripts.text: Yes! Although you pretend not to know, it's the story you all know.
scripts.translation: 是的！雖然你們裝作不知道，但這其實是你們都知道的故事。

scripts.text: The President certainly regrets what happened in the past. His excellency has always been thinking about you and wanted to start a talk.
scripts.translation: 總裁確實對過去發生的事感到後悔。他一直掛念著你們，也想找機會談一談。

scripts.text: Upon your approval, his excellency wants to meet you in person, apologize, and wants to have an opportunity to harmonize with you.
scripts.translation: 只要你們同意，總裁就想親自與你們見面道歉，希望有機會修復彼此的關係。

scripts.text: I was also extremely sad to hear what happened to you. And I was looking for a chance to meet you and talk to you.
scripts.translation: 聽說你們遭遇了那些事，我也非常難過。我一直想找機會和你們見面聊聊。

scripts.text: You are so cool. I like it. Then I will get down to the business.
scripts.translation: 你們真酷。我喜歡這樣。那麼我就直入正題了。

scripts.text: [Lazy began to talk about what happened recently and the request of the President.]
scripts.translation: [懶散開始講起最近發生的事，以及總裁的請求。]

scripts.text: I see. But it's your business and I don't get why we should help you. Do I?
scripts.translation: 我明白了。但這是你們的事，我不懂我們為什麼要幫忙。對吧？

scripts.text: You ignored us when we were in trouble. And you are asking for help now? How can you do that?
scripts.translation: 我們遇到困難時，你們對我們不聞不問。現在卻來求我們幫忙？哪有這樣的道理？

scripts.text: Sounds like a bunch of nonsense. I don't want to listen any more.
scripts.translation: 簡直是一派胡言。我不想再聽了。

scripts.text: That won't harm you under any circumstances!
scripts.translation: 無論如何，這都不會傷害到你們！

scripts.text: The adventurer approved by the royal family of Rune Midgarts is together with us in this mission.
scripts.translation: 這次任務還有一位得到盧恩·米德加茲王室認可的冒險者與我們同行。

scripts.text: With the cooperation of Schwaltzvalt President and Rune Midgarts Kingdom, you can now use the power of the adventurer.
scripts.translation: 施瓦茨瓦爾特總統與盧恩·米德加茲王國攜手合作，如今你們也能借助這位冒險者的力量。

scripts.text: Why would we need the power of the adventurer?
scripts.translation: 我們為什麼需要冒險者的力量？

scripts.text: How can we trust a stranger? Are you going to stab us in the back again?
scripts.translation: 我們怎麼能信任一個陌生人？難道你又要背後捅我們一刀嗎？

scripts.text: This is your opportunity. Along with this cooperation, you can eliminate the dishonor!
scripts.translation: 這是你們的機會。通過這次合作，你們可以洗刷恥辱！

scripts.text: If you cannot trust the President, please trust the adventurer and the royal family of Rune Midgarts. They have already promised a full support.
scripts.translation: 如果你們無法信任總裁，請相信這位冒險者和盧恩·米德加茲王室。他們已經承諾全力支援。

scripts.text: That's right! If you need my help, I will support you actively.
scripts.translation: 沒錯！如果你需要我的幫助，我會積極支援你。

scripts.text: This is not a matter of benefits. It's about our feeling!
scripts.translation: 這不是利益問題，而是我們的感受！

scripts.text: Lucky, thanks for the tea. Send them now. Let the crow go back to its nest.
scripts.translation: 拉基，謝謝你的茶。現在送他們走吧，讓烏鴉回巢。

scripts.text: We will never see them again. So send them gently. Rookie.
scripts.translation: 我們再也不會見他們了。新人，客氣地送他們離開吧。

scripts.text: Please, you can't leave like this...!!!
scripts.translation: 拜託，你們不能就這樣離開...!!!

scripts.text: Hmm... I knew it would be difficult. But I'm surprised that they are not even listening to me.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我知道這會很困難。但沒想到他們連我的話都不肯聽。

scripts.text: Phew. These old men will never change.
scripts.translation: 呼。這些老頭子永遠不會變。

scripts.text: You know it already. Why do you ask?
scripts.translation: 你早就知道了。為什麼還要問？

scripts.text: Sorry. I guess I made a wrong judgment. I should have collected more accurate information.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我判斷錯了。我本該先收集更準確的情報。

scripts.text: What's wrong with you? You make me nervous.
scripts.translation: 你到底怎麼了？你讓我感到不安。

scripts.text: Before I came here, I knew people who were sitting here had the authority, but I now realize that it is a little different.
scripts.translation: 來之前，我知道坐在這裡的人有話語權，但現在看來，實際情況並非如此。

scripts.text: Unless you live here, it's hard to find out who has the authority.
scripts.translation: 如果不是住在這裡的人，很難弄清楚究竟誰說了算。

scripts.text: I don't know what you are talking about. If you finished drinking the tea, please leave.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你在說什麼。如果你茶喝完了，請離開。

scripts.text: Rookie, please help us. If you think about it, you can tell that it's a win-win proposition. You don't want to hide yourself in this corner of the woods forever, do you?
scripts.translation: 新人，請幫幫我們。仔細想想，這對雙方都有好處。你不想永遠躲在這片森林的角落裡吧？

scripts.text: You know that this is the opportunity to take advantage of the government's support and compassion for you. It will provide better fundamentals for Rebellions.
scripts.translation: 這是藉助政府支援、改善你們處境的機會。這也能為反叛者打下更好的基礎。

scripts.text: If this works well. you'll be free to work in Schwaltzvalt and Rune Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 如果一切順利，你們就能自由往來於施瓦茨瓦爾特和盧恩·米德加茲王國。

scripts.text: Look at this place. It's just a tiny shop. Can you call it headquarters? Don't you want to reclaim your glory?
scripts.translation: 看看這裡，不過是間小店，哪像總部？你們不想重振昔日榮光嗎？

scripts.text: And when we are in trouble, you'll abandon us again. There are still many people who haven't washed the wound from what happened in the past. Do you really think they'll help you?
scripts.translation: 可我們一遇到麻煩，你們就會再次拋棄我們。過去發生的事留下的創傷，許多人至今還沒癒合。你真覺得他們會幫你們嗎？

scripts.text: That's why I am asking for your help. I guess you can change their mind by persuading them.
scripts.translation: 所以我才請求你的幫助。我想你可以說服他們改變主意。

scripts.text: In every place, there is a hidden key person who moves the whole group even though you cannot that person easily. Here, it's you.
scripts.translation: 每個團體裡都有一位隱藏的關鍵人物，平時不容易被人發現，卻能推動整個團體。在這裡，那個人就是你。

scripts.text: Well, I guess you are overrating me. They regard me as an unimportant guy here. I dont't take any important mission. All I do is errands and clean-ups. Do you honestly think I'm a key person?
scripts.translation: 嗯，我想你太高看我了。這裡的人覺得我無足輕重。我從沒接過重要任務，只負責跑腿和打掃。你真覺得我是關鍵人物嗎？

scripts.text: No, no. That's not what I am talking about. Normally they call it a mood maker.
scripts.translation: 不，不是那個意思。通常大家會把這種人稱作“氣氛擔當”。

scripts.text: A while ago, you convinced the old men to listen to me. That's what I am talking about. You have such abilities.
scripts.translation: 剛才你說服了那些老前輩聽我把話說完。我指的就是這個，你有這種本事。

scripts.text: I don't know what you mean by 'such abilities'. But I guess you have nothing to talk about by now. The seniors are gone.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你說的“這種本事”是什麼。不過現在你也沒什麼可說的了，前輩們都走了。

scripts.text: That's why I'm trying to help you. Please convince others.
scripts.translation: 所以我才試圖幫助你。請說服其他人。

scripts.text: I have nowhere else to go. Neither does everyone else here. We cannot just help you trusting your promise.
scripts.translation: 我無處可去，這裡其他人也一樣。我們不能只憑你的一句承諾就幫你們。

scripts.text: It may be a matter of cooperation for you. But for us, it's a matter of survival.
scripts.translation: 對你來說，這可能只是合作的問題。但對我們來說，這是生死攸關的問題。

scripts.text: Please. We are also desperate. The fates of the royal family of a country and another country are in danger.
scripts.translation: 求求你們。我們也已經走投無路。兩個國家的王室都危在旦夕。

scripts.text: But if you help us, we can sort it out. That's something only you can do. We really need your help.
scripts.translation: 但如果你幫了我們，一切都能解決。這是隻有你能做到的事。我們真的需要你的幫助。

scripts.text: If you really need help, go to someone else.
scripts.translation: 如果你真的需要幫助，去找別人吧。

scripts.text: You are as cold as ice. How merciless. Please show some mercy and help us.
scripts.translation: 你冷得像冰一樣。真是無情。請發發慈悲，幫幫我們吧。

scripts.text: The people who were sitting here are seniors. They are anchors and symbols of Rebellions.
scripts.translation: 剛才坐在這裡的都是前輩。他們是反叛者的支柱，也是反叛者的象徵。

scripts.text: But as they got old, they retired from the front line. Now they drink tea and watch the junior Rebellions grow up.
scripts.translation: 但他們年紀大了，已經從前線退下來。如今他們喝茶，看著年輕一代的反叛者成長。

scripts.text: So other people are responsible for all the inside jobs. They are the ones ^0000cdwho move the Rebellion practically^000000. They are decision makers.
scripts.translation: 所以內部事務都由其他人負責。他們才是實際推動反叛者運作的人，也是做決定的人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: If you convince them, the public opinion change. Once the public opinion changes, what can seniors do about it?
scripts.translation: 如果你說服了他們，輿論就會改變。輿論一旦轉向，前輩們還能怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Thank you. I prefer those who are wise and smart like you.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你。我更喜歡像你這樣明智聰明的人。

scripts.text: In my opinion, I think it's better for us to be accepted in a wide world rather than living here like this.
scripts.translation: 我覺得，與其像現在這樣困在這裡，不如讓外面的廣闊世界接納我們。

scripts.text: Adventurer, it's time for you to take an action. Please persuade them.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，是時候採取行動了。請說服他們。

scripts.text: Did you seen the response from the seniors? Once I introduce myself, they might shoot at me make dozens of holes in my body.
scripts.translation: 你沒看到前輩們的反應嗎？我要是自報家門，他們說不定會朝我開槍，把我打成篩子。

scripts.text: Since those seniors were relatively rational, we are alive and talking like this. If only there was one person with a short-temper... Phew...
scripts.translation: 幸好那些前輩還算理智，我們才能像現在這樣活著聊天。要是其中有個暴脾氣的...呼...

scripts.text: Adventurer. You are a symbol of faith. Please go and show them your faith. That will take care of everything. Did you see what I did a moment ago? Do as I did.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，你是大家信賴的象徵。去向他們證明這一點吧，這樣一切都會迎刃而解。剛才我做的你看到了吧？照著做就行。

scripts.text: They are in the ^0000cdroom in the 2nd floor2^000000. You can go up and meet them.
scripts.translation: 他們在二樓的房間。你可以上去見他們。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Do you see the rooms on the 2nd floor? I don't know how many of them are there. But you only have to meet the most important people.
scripts.translation: 你看到二樓的房間了嗎？我不知道那裡有多少個房間。但你只需要見最重要的人。

scripts.text: Let's see... You meet ^0000cdRupert^000000, the strict gentleman and ^0000cdElena^000000, the hunting dog first.
scripts.translation: 讓我想想...你先去見魯伯特，那位嚴厲的紳士；再見埃琳娜，那條獵犬。 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: By the way, never call Elena 'hunting dog' in front of her. She's going to disintegrate you.
scripts.translation: 順便說一句，千萬別在埃琳娜面前叫她“獵犬”。她會把你撕碎的。

scripts.text: Anyone else...? Oh, the next one is the good-hearted ^0000cdold women, I mean ladies^000000. Then you meet the Special Force commander ^0000cdErst^000000...
scripts.translation: 還有誰...？哦，接下來是心地善良的老太太——我是說女士們。然後是特種部隊指揮官厄斯特... ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: You can meet these ^0000cdfour teams^000000 and talk to them. As I told you earlier, be careful when you talk. Some of them are short-tempered.
scripts.translation: 你可以去見這四支隊伍，並和他們交談。正如我之前所說，說話時要小心。其中有些人脾氣很暴躁。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Adventurer, good luck! I will be talking to Rookie. Cheer up.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，祝你好運！我去和新人聊聊。加油。

scripts.text: Adventurer! How was it? You met all of them and persuaded them? Not yet? I guess not. If you go to the 2nd floor, you can meet all of them.
scripts.translation: 冒險者！怎麼樣？大家都見到了，也說服他們了嗎？還沒有？我猜也是。上二樓就能見到他們。

scripts.text: I will be cheering for you. Go, adventurer!
scripts.translation: 我會為你加油的。去吧，冒險者！

scripts.text: You're back! So, have you met them? Are they going to help us?
scripts.translation: 你回來了！那麼，你見到他們了嗎？他們會幫助我們嗎？

scripts.text: Yes... Several things happened, but they were not bad.
scripts.translation: 是的...中間雖然出了些狀況，但結果還不錯。

scripts.text: No wonder you are a symbol of faith!! Now, we can wait for seniors and staffs. Right?
scripts.translation: 難怪你是大家信賴的象徵！現在只要等前輩和其他成員回來就行了，對吧？

scripts.text: Come on. Sit here and listen to Rookie's story. It's so interesting.
scripts.translation: 來吧。坐在這裡聽聽新人的故事。非常有趣。

scripts.text: So, why did you leave your home?
It's quite obvious. My family had a secondhand store. As you know, the amount iron consumption is so great in this area. Some people joke that they steal your spoon while your eyes are closed.
scripts.translation: 這還用問嗎？我家開了家二手店。你知道，這一帶的鐵消耗量很大。有人還開玩笑說，趁你閉眼的時候，連勺子都會被偷走。

scripts.text: Normally they use the iron dug from mines. But since it cannot meet the demands, a lot of used iron is also consumed. Our family bought the iron and resold it.
scripts.translation: 平時大家用的是礦裡挖出來的鐵，但產量滿足不了需求，所以也會大量使用廢鐵。我們家就是收購廢鐵再轉賣。

scripts.text: And you were not able to help them?
My brothers helped my parents. As you see, I'm so small and used to be sick when I was a kid.
scripts.translation: 我哥哥們都能幫父母做事。你看我這麼瘦小，小時候還經常生病。

scripts.text: Oh, so they regarded you as a useless kid?
scripts.translation: 哦，所以他們把你看作一個無用的小孩？

scripts.text: I don't agree with you. Everyone has different ability and you must be good at something. You just didn't find it earlier. Anyway, what happened next?
scripts.translation: 我不同意你的看法。每個人都有不同的能力，你肯定擅長某些事情。你只是之前沒發現而已。總之，後來發生了什麼？

scripts.text: As my family ignored me, I decided to leave the house to find something I am capable of.
scripts.translation: 既然家人忽視我，我決定離開家，去尋找我擅長的事情。

scripts.text: Well done. If you stayed there, you would have become such a useless person.
scripts.translation: 做得好。如果你留在那裡，就會變成一個那樣無用的人。

scripts.text: Then I met Gonie and came here. But I found that there's nothing I could do here as well.
scripts.translation: 然後我遇到了戈尼，並來到了這裡。但我發現這裡也沒有我能做的事情。

scripts.text: Everyone is a monster here. Look at Gonie. He was bleeding and almost dead. But He was still alive. The truth is that other guys are extraordinary and you are normal.
scripts.translation: 這裡人人都是怪物。看看戈尼，他渾身是血，幾乎快死了，卻還是活了下來。說到底，別人都身懷絕技，只有你是個普通人。

scripts.text: But I'm not at the level they require here. Whenever I get a gun in my hand, my eyes are sore and my hands are shaking. I can't aim a target properly...
scripts.translation: 可我達不到這裡的要求。每次拿起槍，眼睛就痠痛，手也會發抖，根本瞄不準目標...

scripts.text: So you are in charge of the housekeeping here?
scripts.translation: 所以你是負責這裡的家務？

scripts.text: Not a housekeeping. A sort of cleaning-up?
scripts.translation: 不是家務。算是打掃清理吧？

scripts.text: Hey Rookie. Why did you bring those jerks in here? They are wandering around and humiliating us! Rookie, are you a spy from the government?
scripts.translation: 嘿，新人。你為什麼要帶那些混蛋進來？他們到處亂逛，簡直是在羞辱我們！新人，你是政府的間諜嗎？

scripts.text: The government ignored us when we were dying! We can never help them!
scripts.translation: 政府在我們垂死掙扎時對我們視而不見！我們絕不能幫他們！

scripts.text: Have you forgotten why we are hiding here?
scripts.translation: 你忘了我們為什麼躲在這裡嗎？
這場悲劇是政府造成的！

scripts.text: Fine. You live forever in this isolated place! But what about the children who don't know anything about it?
scripts.translation: 好吧。你就在這與世隔絕的地方永遠生活下去吧！但那些對此一無所知的孩子怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Hey kid! Do you know how much pain we had on that day?
scripts.translation: 嘿，小孩！你知道那天我們遭受了多少痛苦嗎？

scripts.text: I don't know! However, no one else will know it unless we talk about it. Go out there and ask anyone.
scripts.translation: 我不知道！但如果我們不談論它，其他人也不會知道。走出去問問任何人吧。

scripts.text: Ask them if they know that happened on that day. I bet nobody does. Unless we talk about it, how can anyone ever find it out?
scripts.translation: 問問他們是否知道那天發生了什麼。我敢打賭沒人知道。除非我們說出來，否則沒人能發現真相。

scripts.text: You hate to help the government that once abandoned us? It shows that we used to be nothing for them, but now they our help. Does that mean some compensation for us?
scripts.translation: 你討厭幫助那個曾經拋棄我們的政府？這說明我們過去對他們一文不值，如今他們卻需要我們的幫助。這不正好可以作為對我們的補償嗎？

scripts.text: If they need our help, we can just use them. We are not as weak as we used to.
scripts.translation: 如果他們需要我們幫忙，我們可以利用他們。我們不再像以前那樣弱小了。

scripts.text: If you want a revenge, maybe this is the opportunity! A revenge doesn't always mean an armed revenge.
scripts.translation: 如果你想復仇，也許這就是機會！復仇未必非得動武。

scripts.text: You are young and not wise enough. No matter what happens, we are never helping the government. Never!
scripts.translation: 你還年輕，不夠明智。無論發生什麼，我們絕不會幫助政府。絕不！

scripts.text: What the hell is he saying after showing up all of a sudden?
scripts.translation: 他突然出現，到底在說什麼鬼話？

scripts.text: Are you still doing the silent meditation?
scripts.translation: 你還在進行無聲冥想嗎？

scripts.text: Did you hear that? He is in the middle of a silent meditation. How spiteful!
scripts.translation: 聽到了嗎？他正在進行無聲冥想。真夠惡毒的！

scripts.text: Be quiet. I hear it all.
... Gonie says we have to pay for the favor they did to him.
scripts.translation: ...戈尼說，我們必須報答他們對他的恩情。

scripts.text: Well. They did the favor for you, not for us.
scripts.translation: 哼。那是他幫了你，不是幫了我們。

scripts.text: If you want to help them so badly, you two go and help them. But make sure you take the clothes off!
scripts.translation: 你們倆要是這麼想幫他們，就自己去吧。不過記得把衣服脫了！

scripts.text: Did you hear that? They are so cool.
He says everyone on the 2nd floor decided to help them.
scripts.translation: 他說二樓的人都決定要幫他們。

scripts.text: What? The ladies and Rupert as well?
scripts.translation: 什麼？連女士們和魯伯特也一起？

scripts.text: If you are curious, go upstairs and check it. They might slap you on the back.
scripts.translation: 好奇的話就上樓看看吧。他們說不定還會拍拍你的肩膀呢。

scripts.text: Seems like most of us agree. I don't think anything good will happen if you're still against it.
scripts.translation: 看來大家都同意了。如果你還反對，恐怕不會有什麼好事發生。

scripts.text: Phew... Sir, what would you do now? Hehe.
scripts.translation: 呼...前輩，您接下來打算怎麼辦？呵呵。

scripts.text: Oops... We have no other choice if the ladies and Rupert agreed with them...
scripts.translation: 哎呀...既然女士們和魯伯特都答應了...我們也只能照辦了...

scripts.text: But I will never trust you guys! I will keep my eyes on you!!!
scripts.translation: 但我永遠不會信任你們！我會一直盯著你們的！！！

scripts.text: Oh, what a passionate propose. I've never had anything like this in my life. I feel a little shy.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，多麼熱情的提議！我這輩子還沒遇到過這種事，真讓人有點不好意思。

scripts.text: I'm not leaving until I close his big mouth! I'm not leaving!
scripts.translation: 在他閉上那張大嘴之前，我不會離開！我不走！

scripts.text: Yes. Let me handle this place. You go inside and get ready.
scripts.translation: 是的，這裡交給我處理。你們進去準備吧。

scripts.text: I've never imagined that this would be done so perfectly. I owe you for this. Thanks.
scripts.translation: 我從未想過事情會如此完美地解決。我欠你一個人情。謝謝。

scripts.text: Please go and send them a message. Tell them 'The Heron spread its wings' and they will understand.
scripts.translation: 請去給他們送個信。告訴他們“鷺鳥展翅”，他們就會明白的。

scripts.text: Should I go alone? Don't you have to send the message directly?
scripts.translation: 我要一個人去嗎？難道你不應該親自送信嗎？

scripts.text: I am staying here. Hahaha. I really like this fellow and we can work together.
scripts.translation: 我要留在這裡。哈哈哈。我挺喜歡這小夥子的，我們可以一起做事。

scripts.text: Work with me? I don't think I can do anything useful for you.
scripts.translation: 跟我合作？我覺得我幫不上什麼忙。

scripts.text: Exactly. That's something you should change. Self-confidence. In your case, the lack of confidence caused the lack of self-confidence.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。這正是你需要改掉的——缺乏自信。你只是不夠自信而已。

scripts.text: Confidence can be obtained by yourself, through an achievement or by being approved by someone else a person. It's impossible here. This place is like a suit that does not fit for you.
scripts.translation: 自信可以靠自己取得成就，也可以來自他人的認可。在這裡你很難做到。這個地方就像一套不合身的衣服。

scripts.text: As long as there is just one person who trusts you, you can grow to infinity.
scripts.translation: 只要有一個人信任你，你就能無限成長。

scripts.text: You may not have realized it. But you are already doing it to everyone here. They all counting on you. Just trust yourself a little more.
scripts.translation: 你可能還沒意識到，但你已經讓這裡每個人都有了信心。他們都指望著你，多相信自己一點吧。

scripts.text: If you don't get it, trust me. Because I trust you.
scripts.translation: 如果你不明白，那就相信我。因為我信任你。

scripts.text: Now the generation has shifted. Today is the last day for the old generation and the first day for the new generation. And you are the link.
scripts.translation: 現在世代交替了。今天是舊時代的最後一天，也是新時代的第一天。而你就是連線兩者的紐帶。

scripts.text: You're too good to waste your talent here.
scripts.translation: 你太優秀了，不該在這裡浪費才華。

scripts.text: First, you had the ability to find out that I had a certain purpose. You were also able to find out what's helpful for Rebellions. Then you had the guts to implement it. You also have the humanity...
scripts.translation: 首先，你能看出我另有目的，也發現了什麼對反叛者有幫助；之後還敢付諸行動。而且你很有人情味...

scripts.text: Just a little polishing will help you spread your wings. You're supposed to use your brain. Why do you suffer by working physically?
scripts.translation: 只要稍加磨練，你就能展翅高飛。你明明該發揮頭腦，為什麼要靠體力活受苦呢？

scripts.text: If you want, I can help you. What do you think? I need a partner and I'm sure we can make a great duo.
scripts.translation: 如果你願意，我可以幫你。你覺得怎麼樣？我需要搭檔，我相信我們能組成很棒的雙人組。

scripts.text: Oh, could you be explain it to me in detail?
scripts.translation: 哦，你能詳細解釋一下嗎？

scripts.text: Sure. I have plenty of time. By the way, is it okay for me to stay here continuously?
scripts.translation: 當然。我有的是時間。順便問一下，我可以一直留在這裡嗎？

scripts.text: We are now cooperating, aren't we?
scripts.translation: 我們現在不是正在合作嗎？

scripts.text: Don't you think you're scouting him too plainly in someone else's house?
scripts.translation: 你在別人家裡這麼明目張膽地挖人，不覺得太過分嗎？

scripts.text: Is there anything wrong with it? You have this talented guy but you are not utilizing his ability. Are you? He's so talented!
scripts.translation: 這有什麼不對？你身邊明明有這麼有才華的人，卻不讓他發揮本領嗎？他可是很有才能的！

scripts.text: He says we have prepared someone to proceed the cooperation. If you go to the passage to the store, you can meet that person.
scripts.translation: 他說我們已經安排了人來負責合作事宜。你去商店那邊的通道，就能見到那個人。

scripts.text: Yes. I will meet that person and listen.
scripts.translation: 好的。我會去見那個人並聽他怎麼說。

scripts.text: Adventurer, I need to have a long talk from now on. So I'm counting on you. When you go there, don't forget to use that place. I mean 'that place'.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，接下來我得和他們長談一番，就拜託你了。你到了那邊，別忘了用那個地方。我是說“那個地方”。

scripts.text: Pardon? I see.. See you later.
Yikes! Wait a minute! I almost forgot. This is the reward specially prepared for this mission. I am giving all of them to you. You can exchange this with something useful.
scripts.translation: 哎呀！等一下！我差點忘了。這是專門為這次任務準備的獎勵。我把它們都給你。你可以用它們交換有用的東西。

scripts.text: Seems like the dull middle-aged person standing beside the stairs receives the tokens. His name is Strasse. If you are interested, go.
scripts.translation: 樓梯旁站著個沉悶的中年人，負責兌換代幣。他叫斯特拉瑟。感興趣的話就去找他吧。

scripts.text: I gave you everything. Bye now. Say hello to the President!!
scripts.translation: 我都給你了。再見。替我向會長問好！！

scripts.text: Yo! Welcome! Do you want a cup of tea? Did you send the message properly?
scripts.translation: 喲！歡迎！你想喝杯茶嗎？你好好把訊息送出去了嗎？

scripts.text: Tell the guard that Rookie sent you.
scripts.translation: 告訴衛兵是新人派你來的

scripts.text: Although he sent you here, you cannot enter.
scripts.translation: 然是他派你來的，但你不能進入。

scripts.text: Why is it so noisy here?
How many times do you think I told you to be quiet!
scripts.translation: ！我告訴過你多少次要保持安靜！

scripts.text: This person wants to go inside, claiming that Rookie sent him/her.
scripts.translation: ..這個人說是新人派他來的，想進去。

scripts.text: The kid sent you. So, what about it?
scripts.translation: 是那個小孩派你來的。所以，那又怎樣？

scripts.text: You...... You're the one who made a fuss downstairs a moment ago.
scripts.translation: 你...你就是剛才在樓下鬧事的人。

scripts.text: I have no idea what brought you here. But I can't let you in.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你來這裡做什麼，但不能放你進去。

scripts.text: Do not make a fuss. Go back!
You cannot change anything by asking me for a favor.
If it hadn't been for the order of our leader, I could just knock you out right here......
scripts.translation: 要不是首領有令，我剛才就把你打暈在這裡了...

scripts.text: You will be in trouble, if you keep making a fuss.
scripts.translation: 開。再鬧下去，你會有麻煩的。

scripts.text: The exit is downstairs. Go there.
Do you want to die right now?
This is the voice I've never heard before. Is it the adventurer who helped that kid?
scripts.translation: ！這聲音我從沒聽過。是幫助過那個孩子的冒險者嗎？

scripts.text: We cannot leave our savior outside. Let the adventurer come in.
scripts.translation: 。不能讓我們的救命恩人一直待在門外。讓冒險者進

scripts.text: Let me give him/her a cup of tea.
If you behave rudely, you won't go back alive.
scripts.translation: 你要是敢無禮，就別想活著回去。

scripts.text: - The door seems to be locked -
- You hear the conversation from inside the room. -
scripts.translation: - 你聽見房間裡有人在交談。 -

scripts.text: ... So I was thinking that you were having dementia.
scripts.translation: ...我還以為你得了老年痴呆呢。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, you should make yourself up!
scripts.translation: 說起來，你也該打扮打扮了！

scripts.text: This is why you look older!
scripts.translation: 這就是你看起來顯老的原因！

scripts.text: Sometimes you look older than Cotnes!
scripts.translation: 有時候你看起來比科特內斯還老！

scripts.text: It seems like you have more wrinkles these days.
scripts.translation: 你最近皺紋好像變多了。

scripts.text: Why don't you put on some anti-wrinkle cream?
This all is because of the air here!
scripts.translation: 這都是這裡的空氣造成的！

scripts.text: This type of air is critical to the dry skin like yours!
scripts.translation: ！這種空氣最傷你這種乾性皮膚了！

scripts.text: Come to think of it, remember that kid who came here before?
scripts.translation: 說起來，還記得之前來過的那個孩子嗎？讓

scripts.text: Tell him to buy some cosmetics from Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation: 他去盧恩·米德加茲買些化妝品回來！

scripts.text: I have heard there's a fascinating cosmetic shop there.
scripts.translation: 我聽說那邊有家很棒的化妝品店。

scripts.text: It's difficult for our kids to go all the way there to buy cosmetics.
scripts.translation: 讓孩子們跑那麼遠去買化妝品也不容易。

scripts.text: There is a problem with the position as well...
That kid? Who are you talking about?
The kid from the Secret Wings~
scripts.translation: 就是那個秘密之翼來的孩子~

scripts.text: I remember I asked him for an errand. Will he be back here?
scripts.translation: ！我記得我讓他幫我辦過一件事。他會回來嗎？

scripts.text: It's like you solved the whole problem. And they won't get past you.
scripts.translation: 這就像是你一下子解決了所有問題，他們也別想從你這裡溜過去。

scripts.text: Of course, we have some important thoughts~
scripts.translation: 當然，我們也有重要的想法~

scripts.text: You're so great. How can you think of such an idea in that short moment?
scripts.translation: 你真厲害。怎麼能在那麼短的時間內想到這種主意？

scripts.text: Not to mention the president, Heart Hunters are irritating to us as well.
scripts.translation: 不只是總裁，心之獵手也讓我們很頭疼。

scripts.text: Although they are all novices, they can be an obstacle for us in defeating the Secret Wings.
scripts.translation: 雖然他們都是些新手，但我們要是去對付秘密之翼，他們也可能趁機壞事。

scripts.text: Let's say we attack the Secret Wings recklessly and Heart Hunters takes the chance to attack us. We'll collapse in a minute.
scripts.translation: 假如我們貿然攻擊秘密之翼，心之獵手又趁機反咬一口，我們很快就會全盤崩潰。

scripts.text: So we will pretend to cooperate with the Secret Wings and get rid of the annoying ones first.
scripts.translation: 所以我們先假裝和秘密之翼合作，優先除掉那些礙事的傢伙。

scripts.text: Let's finish them before they realize we have a plan to attack them.
scripts.translation: 趁他們還沒察覺我們的計劃，先把他們解決掉。

scripts.text: We're Rebellions. And we are at the end of guns.
scripts.translation: 我們可是反叛者，早已身處槍口之下。

scripts.text: Let me finish my karma in my generation.
scripts.translation: 就讓我在這一代了結這段恩怨吧

scripts.text: I don't want to leave it to youngsters.
This is good to have this opportunity before I die.
scripts.translation: 能在死前得到這樣的機會，真是太好了。

scripts.text: I saw Rupert crying after you said that.
scripts.translation: 我剛才看到魯伯特聽到你這麼說後哭了。

scripts.text: He's not cute anymore, he is just a middle-aged man. But to him, you're like mother.
scripts.translation: 他已經不可愛了，只是箇中年大叔。但在他眼裡，你就像母親一樣。

scripts.text: What we have now is a pleasant party. I'm looking forward to it.
scripts.translation: 我們現在終於能辦一場熱鬧的聚會了，我很期待。哈

scripts.text: Then I'll fix the party accessories in advance.
scripts.translation: 那我就提前準備好聚會的裝飾品吧。呵

scripts.text: Take a seat and have some cookies.
It's dangerous to be excited at our age...

scripts.text: No mission? Then what happened to the mission I did?
scripts.translation: 沒有任務？那我執行的任務是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: I'm curious about it, too. I know you are exhausted after coming back from your mission. But please tell me about your mission in detail.
scripts.translation: 我也很好奇。知道你剛出任務回來很疲憊，不過還是請詳細說說任務經過。

scripts.text: You told the Rebellion leader about what happened during your mission to eliminate Teleport prohibition equipment of Schwaltzvalt with Vero.
scripts.translation: 你向反叛者首領講述了與維羅一起執行的任務，內容是摧毀施瓦茨瓦爾特（Schwaltzvalt）的禁止瞬間移動裝置。

scripts.text: Arivero Yurhik.. As you said, that Gunslinger's surname seems to be same with that of Noa here.
scripts.translation: 阿里維羅·尤爾希克...正如你所說，那位神槍手的姓氏似乎和諾亞一樣。

scripts.text: But as far as I can remember, there is no Gunslinger named Arivero Yurhik in Clana Nemieri..
scripts.translation: 但據我所知，克拉納·內米埃裡並沒有叫阿里維羅·尤爾希克的神槍手...

scripts.text: Oops?! I don't get it.. Although he disappeared in Einbroch all of a sudden, he was certainly doing the mission with me..
scripts.translation: 咦？！我不明白...雖然他突然在艾音布羅克消失了，但他確實一直和我一起執行任務...

scripts.text: Wait! Calm down and listen to me.
The young man named Arivero told you he's a younger brother of Noa. Right?
scripts.translation: 那個叫阿里維羅的年輕人告訴你，他是諾亞的弟弟，對吧？

scripts.text: I have a strong feeling that Arivero guy you met is Noa's brother, even if Noa's younger brother died in an accident when he was young.
scripts.translation: 我強烈覺得你遇到的阿里維羅就是諾亞的弟弟，儘管諾亞的弟弟小時候就因意外去世了。

scripts.text: Really?! Did you say he died..?
scripts.translation: 真的嗎？！你說他已經去世了...？

scripts.text: In this world, there are so many things that we cannot identify.
scripts.translation: 這個世界上有很多事情，我們至今都無法解釋。

scripts.text: I can't tell you any further, because it is Noa's personal information. Let's not talk about this anymore. By the way..
scripts.translation: 那是諾亞的私事，我不能再多說。我們別再談這個了。對了...

scripts.text: You did a great job. Maybe, two of you?
scripts.translation: 你們做得很好。也許該說是

scripts.text: You two destroyed all Teleport prohibition equipment of Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation: 你們兩位？你們摧毀了施瓦茨瓦爾特所有的禁制

scripts.text: Although the mission started unusually, it is surely a remarkable achievement.
scripts.translation: 裝置。任務雖然開始得很離奇，但成果確實了不起。

scripts.text: Since it was not an official mission, I cannot give you a huge reward. But it's still a remarkable achievement.
scripts.translation: 由於這不是官方任務，我無法給你們豐厚的獎勵。但這仍然是一項了不起的成就。

scripts.text: Let's say this is a small compensation for your great work.
scripts.translation: 就把這個當作對你們出色表現的一點謝禮吧。

scripts.text: The Rebellion leader disappeared like that.
scripts.translation: 反叛者首領就這樣消失了。我

scripts.text: What the hell happened to me?
I will remember this as a mission with various questions remaining.
scripts.translation: 這趟任務留下了許多未解之謎，我會一直記得。

scripts.text: Welcome, pal. Have you brought the item full of fire attributes that I asked you for?
scripts.translation: 歡迎，夥計。帶來我讓你找的火屬性物品了嗎？

scripts.text: Not yet? Please bring an item full of Fire attributes.
scripts.translation: 還沒嗎？請帶來火屬性強的物品。

scripts.text: Welcome, pal. Have you brought the item full of fire attributes that I asked you for?
scripts.translation: 歡迎，夥計。你帶來我讓你找的那個充滿火屬性力量的物品了嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, Flame Heart? I heard it's an item with a strong fire attribute.
scripts.translation: ？哦，火靈原石啊。我聽說它蘊含很強的火屬性。

scripts.text: Shall I try? Let's see. This seems to be the place the agent told us about. Now we have to break the Flame Heart you brought into pieces..
scripts.translation: 我試試看...這裡應該就是特工說的地點。現在把你帶來的火靈原石敲碎...

scripts.text: The equipment showed up. Yikes! Turn on the device you brought before the equipment disappears..
scripts.translation: ！裝置出現了。哎呀！趁它消失前，趕快啟動你帶來的固定裝置...

scripts.text: It was a vague theory, but it succeeded.
scripts.translation: 雖然這只是個粗略的推測，但真的成功了。
夥計，我們要把它摧毀嗎？

scripts.text: I thought the attack was strong enough..
scripts.translation: 我還以為剛才那下足夠有力...

scripts.text: Oh! Perhaps..? Hey, pal. This equipment has a Fire attribute. What is the attribute opposite to Fire?
scripts.translation: 哦！難道...？嘿，夥計，這臺裝置是火屬性的。火屬性相剋的是什麼？

scripts.text: That's it!! Water!! A water attribute.
If we attack it using a Water attribute, the equipment will be destroyed. Hey, pal. Bring an item with a strong Water attribute.
scripts.translation: 只要用水屬性攻擊，裝置就會被摧毀。夥計，去找水屬性強的物品來。

scripts.text: Obviously we will need more than one. Please bring me several of those. I will be guarding here to prevent the equipment from disappearing.
scripts.translation: 顯然一個不夠。請多帶幾個來，我會留在這裡看守，免得裝置消失。

scripts.text: Welcome, pal. Have you brought the item full of Water attributes that I asked you for?
scripts.translation: 歡迎，夥計。你帶來我讓你找的那個充滿水屬性力量的物品了嗎？

scripts.text: We need an item that has a strong Water attribute.
scripts.translation: ？我們需要一個水屬性很強的物品。

scripts.text: Mystic Frozen? Certainly it's an item that has a strong Water attribute. Right. Mystic Frozen will be the equipment strong enough for our purpose. But one or two will not be enough.
scripts.translation: 水靈原石？它確實蘊含很強的水屬性。沒錯，應該足以對付這臺裝置。不過一兩塊不夠。

scripts.text: I think we need at least three of them.
Mystic Frozen? Certainly it's an item that has a strong Water attribute. Right. Mystic Frozen will be the equipment strong enough for our purpose. Let's try it.
scripts.translation: 水靈原石？它確實蘊含很強的水屬性，足夠對付這臺裝置。我們試試看吧。
太好了！我們摧毀了裝置。

scripts.text: Although we destroyed the equipment, there is some magic power remaining. Therefore, teleporting will not be possible in this area for a while.
scripts.translation: 夥計。雖然裝置摧毀了，但仍殘留一些魔力，所以這片區域暫時無法使用瞬間移動。

scripts.text: But, eventually, teleporting will become possible.
scripts.translation: 不過，等魔力消散後，就能恢復瞬間移動了。

scripts.text: We destroyed the prohibition equipment. Now let's go back to Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation: 禁制裝置已經摧毀。現在回克拉納·內米埃裡吧。

scripts.text: Sorry! Sorry! As a matter of fact, I arrived here early. But I had to talk to the agent to get the right location. I should have arrived and called you in advance. Sorry to make you come here alone.
scripts.translation: 抱歉！真的抱歉！其實我早就到了，但得先找特工確認準確位置。我應該早點通知你，讓你別一個人跑來。

scripts.text: Coming all the way here only with that information! I could not find this, so I had to meet the agent.
scripts.translation: ！光憑那點情報就找到這裡了！我自己找不到，只好去見特工。

scripts.text: The important thing is that we both arrived here safely. Remember I asked you to bring one Mystic Frozen and three Rough Winds. Right?
scripts.translation: 最重要的是我們都平安到了。記得我讓你帶一塊水靈原石和三塊風靈原石吧？

scripts.text: Where are the items I asked you for?
We must destroy this before they realize that the equipment items are being destroyed one by one. Bring them quickly.
scripts.translation: 趁他們還沒發現裝置一臺臺被毀，我們得趕緊摧毀這裡這臺。快拿來。

scripts.text: I might look suspicious, so I will hide myself.
scripts.translation: 我在這裡太顯眼了，先躲起來。

scripts.text: Sorry! Sorry! As a matter of fact, I arrived here early. But I had to talk to the agent to get the right location. I should have arrived and called you in advance. Sorry to make you come here alone.
scripts.translation: 抱歉！抱歉！其實我早就到了。但我必須找特工確認準確的位置。我應該早點到並通知你的。抱歉讓你一個人跑來這裡。

scripts.text: Coming all the way here only with that information! I could not find this, so I had to meet the agent.
scripts.translation: ！只憑那些資訊就一路找來了！我找不到這裡，所以不得不去見特工。

scripts.text: The important thing is that we both arrived here safely. Remember I asked you to bring one Mystic Frozen and three Rough Winds. Right?
scripts.translation: 重要的是我們都安全地到了這裡。記得我讓你帶一個水靈原石和三個風靈原石吧？

scripts.text: Mystic Frozen. The location is clear, because I checked it with our agent. If we break the Mystic Frozen you brought into pieces..
scripts.translation: 水靈原石。位置很明確，因為我通過特工確認過了。如果我們把你帶來的水靈原石打碎...

scripts.text: Good! The equipment has showed up..
And we installed the device we brought..
scripts.translation: 們帶來的固定裝置也安好了...

scripts.text: Great. Now we can destroy it. Prepare the Rough Wind.
scripts.translation: 太好了。現在我們可以摧毀它了。準備好風靈原石。

scripts.text: Nevertheless, the first one is always tough and it is easier from the second one. Now let us disappear with teleporting..
scripts.translation: 不過，第一臺總是最難的，之後就容易多了。現在用瞬間移動撤離吧...

scripts.text: We cannot teleport immediately after destroying it. I told you about it and I forgot it myself! What a shame.
scripts.translation: 。摧毀後不能立刻使用瞬間移動。我告訴過你的，結果我自己都忘了！真丟人。

scripts.text: Ha! In the past, due to the magic power of this prohibition equipment.. Oh! It's nothing.
scripts.translation: 哈！之前都是因為這臺禁制裝置的魔力...哦，沒什麼。總之，我們

scripts.text: To avoid getting caught, let's scatter.
scripts.translation: 為了不被發現，我們分頭行動吧。

scripts.text: Is this it? The mansion surrounded by water? According to the condition, it seems like it.
scripts.translation: 這是那座宅邸嗎？四面都被水環繞...看來符合條件。

scripts.text: Oops?! My hot friend has already arrived.
scripts.translation: 哎呀？！我最酷的朋友已經到了。

scripts.text: Welcome, pal! I have just arrived now. I summoned the equipment and mounted it to prevent from disappearing.
scripts.translation: 歡迎，夥計！我剛到這裡，已經把固定裝置架好了，免得裝置消失。

scripts.text: Not yet. I will be guarding this here. Please bring it quickly.
scripts.translation: 還沒帶來嗎？我會在這裡看守，請儘快拿來

scripts.text: According to our agent, Rekenber and the government are serious now.
scripts.translation: 。特工說雷肯貝爾和政府都認真起來了。

scripts.text: You are a reliable friend of mine.
scripts.translation: 你可是我信得過的朋友

scripts.text: Since we don't have enough time, let's destroy the equipment quickly and go to Einbroch. According to our agent, Rekenber and the government are serious now.
scripts.translation: 。時間不多了，我們趕緊摧毀裝置，再去艾音布羅克。特工說雷肯貝爾和政府已經開始認真應對了。

scripts.text: I will destroy the equipment right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在就摧毀裝備。準備

scripts.text: We destroyed the prohibition equipment and there appear to be.. no eyewitnesses. Just in case, let's scatter and move to Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 禁制裝置已經摧毀，而且似乎沒有目擊者。保險起見，我們分頭前往艾音布羅克吧。

scripts.text: Oh! I haven't told you the location.
It is the place where Einbroch Wind turbine is located. You bring three Flame Hearts and one remaining Great Nature. We will use them to destroy the equipment.
scripts.translation: 就在艾音布羅克的風車那裡。你帶三塊火靈原石和一塊剩下的土靈原石過來。我們要用它們來摧毀裝置。

scripts.text: Vero disappeared in a hurry, as if he was being chased by something. Take three Flame Hearts and one Great Nature and go to Einbroch.
scripts.translation: 維羅匆忙消失了，好像被什麼東西追趕著。帶上三塊火靈原石和一塊土靈原石，去艾音布羅克。

scripts.text: have you brought three Flame Hearts and one Great Nature?
scripts.translation: 你帶三塊火靈原石和一塊土靈原石了嗎？

scripts.text: Vero is pressing me, as if he does not have much time left. Something is fish. But I'm not asking him, as I know he won't tell me.
scripts.translation: 維羅催得很急，好像剩下的時間不多了。總覺得哪裡不對勁。不過我沒問他，因為知道他不會說。

scripts.text: Please. And the last one is...
No! Nothing. Please bring it here as soon as possible.
scripts.translation: 件...不，沒什麼。請儘快帶來。

scripts.text: Great! Destroy the Great Nature now, so that the equipment will show up!!
scripts.translation: 太好了！現在把土靈原石弄碎，讓裝置顯現出來！！

scripts.text: His voice betrays his panic. And he also asked me to do the job that he had been doing by himself. Is there something wrong? I was curious. I broke the Great Nature into pieces as he asked.
scripts.translation: 他的聲音裡透著慌亂。他還讓我來做原本一直由他親自做的事。到底出了什麼問題？我心裡犯嘀咕，但還是照他的要求把土靈原石砸碎了。

scripts.text: Now! Time to use the Flame Heart!
scripts.translation: 現在！是時候用火靈原石了！

scripts.text: As Vero asked me, I smashed the Teleport Prohibition equipment with the Flame Heart.
scripts.translation: 我照維羅說的，用火靈原石砸毀了瞬間移動禁制裝置。

scripts.text: The equipment was destroyed quickly. Then I realized that Vero looked a bit abnormal. Is he sick or something?
scripts.translation: 裝置很快就被摧毀了。我這才注意到維羅有些不對勁。他是不是病了？

scripts.text: Hey, pal! I know I have been naughty. But, thanks to your support, I managed to eliminate every Teleport Prohibition equipment in Schwaltzvalt.
scripts.translation: 嘿，夥計！我知道自己一直有點胡鬧。不過多虧你幫忙，我才成功摧毀了施瓦茨瓦爾特所有的瞬間移動禁制裝置

scripts.text: Thank you for helping me. This was my wish.
scripts.translation: 。謝謝你幫我實現了這個心願。

scripts.text: What.. Why are you saying that?
scripts.translation: 什麼...你為什麼突然這麼說

scripts.text: As if you were going far away?
What's that look? Hahaha. I would like to take a photo of you. Well..
scripts.translation: 幹嗎這副表情？哈哈哈。我想給你拍張照。嗯...

scripts.text: I must be showing my gratitude now. But I have to ask you for one more favor. Please talk to my elder sister once in a while. She is lonely quite often..
scripts.translation: 我該好好向你道謝。不過還想請你再幫個忙：偶爾去陪我姐姐聊聊天吧，她常常很孤單...

scripts.text: Vero disappeared all of a sudden after saying goodbye. What's going on here? Has he been summoned for an urgent mission?
scripts.translation: 維羅道別後便突然消失了。到底怎麼回事？他是被緊急召去執行任務了嗎？維羅走了

scripts.text: Vero's gone. Shall I go back to Clana Nemieri?
You... You're the adventurer who showed up with the Secret Wings.
scripts.translation: 你...你就是那個和秘密之翼一起來的冒險者。

scripts.text: What can I do for you?
You told him what you heard from Elena Volkova and asked him for a consultation.
scripts.translation: 你告訴他從埃琳娜·沃爾科娃那裡聽來的訊息，並向他請教。

scripts.text: If it was about the Secret Wings, I would not have mentioned anything. But for that issue, I will help you.
scripts.translation: 如果是秘密之翼的事，我本來不會多說。不過這件事我願意幫忙。正如沃爾科娃

scripts.text: As commander Volkova said, I brought those kids.
scripts.translation: 指揮官所說，我把那些孩子帶來了。

scripts.text: ...I heard what happened to them lately. But I didn't know they were suffering like that.
scripts.translation: ...我最近聽說了他們的遭遇，卻不知道他們一直過得那麼辛苦。

scripts.text: I want to talk to Lebedev twins myself. But it is an arrogation and it will be bad for Commander Volkova.
scripts.translation: 我想親自和列別捷夫雙胞胎談談，但那樣會越權，也會給沃爾科娃指揮官帶來

scripts.text: Commander Volkova knows that too. That's why she sent you.
scripts.translation: 麻煩。她也明白這一點，所以才派你來。

scripts.text: There are some people who do not like commander Volkova.
scripts.translation: 有些人不喜歡沃爾科娃指揮官。她

scripts.text: Her unit is USU. The commander didn't manage to take care of her squadders so the squadders talked to their former commander? It's a bad scenario.
scripts.translation: 的部隊叫USU。要是她沒照顧好自己的隊員，隊員轉而求助前任指揮官，那局面可就難看了。

scripts.text: Let me give you this. Eat them together with the twins. And tell them to trust me and tell their problems to you.
scripts.translation: 把這個拿去和雙胞胎一起吃。告訴他們信任我，把煩惱都告訴你。

scripts.text: Forget advices or recommendations and just listen to them for a while. They are good kids and they will definitely understand you. Got it?
scripts.translation: 別急著給建議，先聽他們說一會兒。他們都是好孩子，一定會理解你的。明白嗎？

scripts.text: You're back! Don't be so nervous. They are good kids. Go speak to them.
scripts.translation: 你回來了！別緊張，他們都是好孩子。去跟他們聊聊吧。

scripts.text: Don't preach at them too much. If they have problems, listen to them. Make sure you give them cookies.
scripts.translation: 別對他們說教太多。有煩惱就聽他們說。記得把餅乾給他們。

scripts.text: Then I have no choice but to eat them. Give them to me.
scripts.translation: 胎做的嗎？那我可得嚐嚐。拿來吧。

scripts.text: You said there were cookies. Where are they?
scripts.translation: 你剛才說有餅乾呢？在哪兒？

scripts.text: Smells good. Of course it's not as good as Lucy's...
scripts.translation: 聞起來不錯。當然還是不如露西做的...

scripts.text: I'm happy, thank you. One bouquet for today is enough.
scripts.translation: 我很高興，謝謝。今天的一束花足夠了。

scripts.text: You must have other things to do, come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 你肯定還有其他事要做，明天再來吧。

scripts.text: You are the adventurer who created a huge noise in our hideout.
scripts.translation: 你就是那個在我們據點鬧出大動靜的冒險者。

scripts.text: By the way, ... Hmm, no. Never mind.
(... Seems like he wants to say something.)
Would you like to say anything?
Oh, actually... I wanted to ask you for a little favor.
scripts.translation: 啊，其實...我想請你幫個小忙。

scripts.text: You'll have to visit Einbroch for a while. Would you accept it?
scripts.translation: 你得去一趟艾音布羅克。願意幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: Thanks. It's not a tough job.
If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find a ^0000CDflower girl^000000.
scripts.translation: 音布羅克天文臺往南走，會遇到一位賣花女孩。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: Could you buy a Bunch Of Flowers from that kid and lay it beneath the tree beside her?
scripts.translation: 向那孩子買一束花，放在她旁邊那棵樹下。

scripts.text: There is a small sign below the tree, so you will find it easily.
scripts.translation: 樹下有塊小牌子，很容易找到。

scripts.text: I will count on you. Come back and report, I mean... tell me.
scripts.translation: 拜託你了。回來告訴我...我是說，回來向我彙報。

scripts.text: Buy a Bunch Of Flowers from ^0000CDflower girl^000000 and lay it beneath the tree.
scripts.translation: 從賣花女孩那裡買一束花，放在 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find it.
scripts.translation: 樹下。從艾音布羅克天文臺往南走就能找到。

scripts.text: Buy a Bunch Of Flowers from ^0000CDflower girl^000000 and lay it beneath the tree.
scripts.translation: 從賣花女孩那裡買一束花，放在 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: If you go south from the Einbroch observatory, you will find it.
scripts.translation: 樹下。從艾音布羅克天文臺往南走就能找到。

scripts.text: Really? That's good. Didn't she say anything else to you?
scripts.translation: 是嗎？那很好。她沒跟你說別的？很好，

scripts.text: Great. Please don't tell about it anyone else except Lebedev twins.
scripts.translation: 這件事除了列別捷夫雙胞胎，別告訴其他任何人。

scripts.text: They used to help me for this. But I cannot request them now.
scripts.translation: 以前他們會幫我做這件事，但現在我不能再拜託他們了。

scripts.text: I see. What did she say?
You told him what you heard from Lucy.
scripts.translation: 你告訴他你從露西那裡聽到的話。

scripts.text: Dried filefish fillet? Are you selling it? Oh, I don't have tooth so I can't eat it.
scripts.translation: 乾魚片？你要賣給我嗎？我沒牙了，吃不了。

scripts.text: What? Lunch? I've had it already. Hehe...
scripts.translation: 什麼？午飯？我已經吃過了。呵呵...

scripts.translation: 伙食難吃可不是我的錯。只要

scripts.translation: 多給我點時間和預算，我就能做出更好的飯菜。

scripts.text: Phew, what should I serve the gluttons today? What would they like...?
scripts.translation: 唉，今天該給那些大胃王做什麼呢？他們會喜歡什麼...？

scripts.translation: 幾年前，指揮官埃裡克森把她們帶到這裡。

scripts.translation: 她們訓練得很順利，射擊尤其出色，很快就成了反叛者的一員。

scripts.text: They have been trainees for a while and several month ago, they went on the real mission for the first time. That's when they stirred up trouble.
scripts.translation: 她們當了一陣子學員，幾個月前第一次執行實戰任務。就是那時出了岔子。

scripts.text: Some people said that the younger sister threw a grenade at the civilian zone. But I don't know the exact story.
scripts.translation: 有人說妹妹朝平民區扔了手榴彈，但具體情況我也不清楚。

scripts.text: After that, they were moved to USU, became more educated, etc. There was a fuss.
scripts.translation: 之後她們被調到USU，接受了進一步訓練...當時鬧出不

scripts.translation: 少風波。從那以後，她們開始不聽

scripts.text: After that incident, they never came. Just by hearing the stories about them, I don't feel like they are the same kids I used to know.
scripts.translation: 那件事之後，她們就再也沒來過。光聽那些傳聞，我都覺得她們不像我以前認識的孩子了。她們

scripts.text: This is all I can tell you.

scripts.translation: 我怎麼知道你是冒險者？很簡單。

scripts.text: A stranger rarely visits this place. So someone like you draws everybody's attention.
scripts.translation: 這裡很少有陌生人來，像你這樣的人自然會引起大家注意。

scripts.text: Since I have to cook for our gluttons, I cannot go out too far. So I am sorry that I haven't been able to prepare something delicious.
scripts.translation: 我還得給那群大胃王做飯，實在走不開。抱歉一直沒能準備好吃的。

scripts.text: You are an adventurer who travels around the whole world! Please bring something delicious for our seniors and me!
scripts.translation: 您是走遍世界的冒險者！請給前輩們和我帶些好吃的回來吧！

scripts.text: If the food is too expensive, it might me troublesome for you to get it. Please bring one of the following list.

scripts.translation: 帶其中一樣回來，前輩們就會

scripts.text: All I can get around this place are butter with an unpleasant smell and withered herbs. I can't make anything nice with them.
scripts.translation: 這附近只有味道難聞的黃油和乾癟的草藥，根本做不出好吃的東西。說到底，

Well! Haha, thank you for your kindness!

scripts.text: ... What, you haven't brought any of them?
Oh, it's been a long time since Charity went out. She ate all the forage!
scripts.translation: 慈善出去很久了，連貓糧都吃光了！也

scripts.text: Hey, adventurer. Do you know the idol of our unit?
scripts.translation: 嘿，冒險者。你知道我們小隊的偶像是誰嗎？艾
